title: Digimon Story Time Stranger Game Reveals 'A Hero's Eternal Legacy' DLC Expansion
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America revealed during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a trailer for its Digimon Story Time Stranger game , and it announces the major DLC expansion "A Hero's Eternal Legacy." The new expansion will take place three years after the original game, and it will feature a new hero…
author: ANN

title: Stupid Never Dies Game's 3rd Trailer Reveals Demo
content: Osaka-based game development studio GPTrack50 unveiled during Sony 's Stage of Play livestream on Thursday the third trailer for Stupid Never Dies action game , and it reveals that a two-hour playable demo has launched. Save data from the First Bite demo can transfer to the full game upon launch.
author: ANN

title: Cygames Announces Where the Seeds Fall Game From Newly Established Label CygamesEdge
content: Cygames announced a new label on Thursday CygamesEdge for small and mid-sized teams. CygamesEdge unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday its debut game Where the Seeds Fall from ZEREO.
author: ANN

title: Giant Ojo-sama Anime Reveals First Trailer, Yu Serizawa and Junya Enoki Lead Voice Cast
content: Giant Ojo-sama ( Giant Young Lady ) anime revealed the first trailer, along with the main voice cast. The anime previously confirmed a January 2027 release date . Studio Tatsunoko Production is in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Apothecary Diaries Is Going Live-Action & It Already Has the Creator’s Approval
content: The Apothecary Diaries is one of the largest franchises in recent years, known for its exceptional story and gorgeous animation. Written by Hyūganatsu, the critically acclaimed light novel received an anime adaptation in 2023, and the series only continues to grow in popularity.
author: ComicBook

title: Rev. Noir Game's Trailers Reveal 2027 Release, Preview Story/Combat (Updated)
content: Konami Digital Entertainment unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday the second trailer for its new role-playing game Rev. Noir . Update: Konami later revealed that the game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: NIS America Announces The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes Game
content: NIS America announced during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday The Eminence in Shadow : Phantom Echoes , a new 3D action roguelite game based on Daisuke Aizawa 's The Eminence in Shadow ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: Fate/Extra Record Game's Trailer Reveals January 28 Release
content: Aniplex unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a trailer for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game.
author: ANN

title: Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game's Trailer Reveals March 2027 Release
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a trailer on Thursday for Gundam Rogue Orbit , a new game in the Gundam franchise , and it reveals that the game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam in March 2027. The video previews the story, characters, and gameplay.
author: ANN

title: 'Giant Ojousama' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Q Nikumura 's Giant Ojousama manga revealed the main cast, additional staff members, and a teaser promotional video on Friday.
